title: 星序观星主页面重构视觉提案
status: 视觉提案，待用户看图后确定；未修改页面实现

images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: a high-fidelity redesigned desktop homepage SCREENSHOT for the existing Chinese learning platform 星序 Astra. Recompose the existing homepage design into a refined, usable 16:9 landscape interface, ideally 2048 x 1152. This is a visual design proposal, not code. No device frame, no browser chrome, no presentation board margins.
INPUTS: Image 1 is the current website visual reference, only use its coastal stargazing world and brand identity. REMOVE the large open catalogue panels and redesign the resting homepage composition. Image 2 is the established child identity/clothing/age reference; show the same small 7–9-year-old child at a MUCH SMALLER environmental scale. Image 3 is the exact brand mark, preserve its signature Chinese 星序 and Astra appearance at modest size in the top left.
MAIN COMPOSITION: A wide, spacious night ocean and star-filled sky. Sky occupies the upper 62 percent; a level distant horizon at y=62 percent; the blue ocean remains clearly visible across most of the lower 38 percent. A restrained dusty lavender/rose and pale champagne glow lies narrowly along the horizon. Rolling sea swells, fine broken moonlike highlights and tasteful natural foam, convincing depth. The right-hand basalt cliff is confined to the lower-right 23 percent of the width and the bottom 24 percent of the height, its standing ledge around y=77 percent. A small child and compact realistic refractor telescope on a complete three-legged tripod stand on the ledge at x=85 percent. Child full-body height only about 16 percent of screen height, a dark nuanced silhouette with cool rim lighting, eye precisely meets telescope eyepiece, facing left/up. Child, tripod, cliff and ocean must be spatially believable and visually subordinate to the sky. No giant foreground wall.
ACTIVE COURSE NEBULA: ONE very beautiful astrophotographic ice-blue/silver nebula in the upper-left-middle sky, center x=31 percent y=31 percent, irregular broken shell with intricate gas filaments, depth and dark dust lanes, softly feathered edges. Roughly 26 percent screen width. Far right a very faint distant Milky Way gives depth, not another prominent cluster. Nebula light gently affects nearby small stars, wispy atmosphere and a narrow irregular ocean reflection; coherent environmental lighting. Subtle fine drifting star trails and a single thin meteor imply animation. No diagram circles, planetary rings, fake wireframe spheres or cluster of spiral-galaxy icons.
USABLE UI: Clear legible Chinese text, aligned to a precise grid. At x=26 percent y=48 percent, below the nebula and comfortably above the horizon, place a tasteful course identity area in negative space: heading exactly "工科实验室" in elegant restrained light serif, supporting text "5 个学科 · 90 项实验", and an understated thin outlined cut-corner button "查看课程 →". No large card background. Titles and controls use accessible off-white contrast and clear click affordances.
TOP BAR: sparse overlay only, no heavy filled header. Far upper-left a small gold five-point STAR button with a thin chamfered-square outline, beside it the supplied 星序 Astra logo. This star opens the existing seven-star Big Dipper menu; show closed state in this image and keep the button clearly visible. Upper-right text exactly "欢迎回来，旅人".
BOTTOM: a calm low-height translucent dark-blue navigation strip, leaving scenery visible above. Lower-left small telescope line icon and text "课程目录 →". In the center four evenly spaced readable text buttons exactly "工科实验室", "代码空间", "未来星系", "AI智境"; first item selected with a small champagne star marker and short fine line, other items understated but clearly legible. Slightly above the center bar, small readable helper "拖动星空探索 · 滚轮缩放". Lower-right compact minus / recenter / plus / pause icon controls. Consistent thin-stroke metal-blue iconography, generous tap targets, no massive HUD or floating cards.
STYLE: polished realistic cinematic night photography/matte painting with fine film grain, natural material roughness, low-key navy/charcoal, restrained silver-blue and localized pale gold, very small touches dusty pink and violet. Unified photographic lighting and atmospheric perspective. Beautiful but calm, a usable learning platform. Avoid oversaturated AI fantasy wallpaper, excessive glow, noisy glitter, thick white outlines, orange sun, luminous giant moon, low-poly child, giant lettering, opaque dashboards, invented progress/achievements, watermarks, extra text. Preserve all four clearly named learning destinations and the star menu trigger.

Use case: ui-mockup / layout adaptation. Image 1 is the exact approved-for-exploration DESKTOP visual direction of the 星序 Astra learning homepage, and is the edit target/style source. Produce its meticulously re-composed MOBILE responsive homepage, a single edge-to-edge portrait screenshot, aspect ratio approximately 9:19, ideally 1024x2160. No phone mockup, no browser chrome, no poster margins. This must be the SAME coastal astronomical world, same child, telescope, logo, blue/silver nebula, dark navy palette, restrained dusty rose and champagne horizon, precise understated interface.
The purpose is to prove that the narrow layout remains spacious and usable rather than cropping the desktop and enlarging the child and cliff.
COMPOSITION: Top bar at y=3–8 percent: small gold five-point STAR menu button on the far left, supplied signature 星序 Astra logo beside it, right side concise greeting "欢迎回来，旅人" with small user chevron. Keep the Big Dipper menu CLOSED; the visible gold star remains its trigger. ONE elegant irregular astrophotographic blue nebula floats centered at x=48%,y=25%, width about 68% of screen, with delicate star points, diffuse filaments, and airy dark negative space. Soft distant Milky Way at the upper-right edge rather than a heavy bright stripe. A single thin meteor. Nebula illumination gently tints nearby stars and a narrow sea reflection.
ACTIVE COURSE COPY: Positioned around y=41–49%, centered and fully readable: "工科实验室"; below "5 个学科 · 90 项实验"; one comfortably tappable thin chamfered-outline button "查看课程 →". Clear light typography, short text, no giant card hiding the sky.
A level ocean horizon at y=57%. The ocean has real rolling slate-blue swells with fine broken white foam and reflects a restrained narrow pale pink/champagne and blue glow. Keep OPEN OCEAN clearly visible from the left edge across at least 65% of the width, down to the lower controls. A low cliff occupies only the lower-right corner, at x=73–100%, y=76–87%. The same small child with telescope is seen FULL BODY on that ledge. The child's body height is only 13% of screen height, roughly x=87%, feet y=78%. Telescope and eyepiece align naturally, all tripod feet on rock. Child remains still, dark silhouette with soft cool rim, facing left/up into the instrument. DO NOT fill the lower half with a giant cliff, rocks or character.
MOBILE UI: At y=82% place one low-profile full-width usable course-directory control with telescope line icon and exact label "课程目录 →", and a small pause icon at its right. Below it, four clearly named destination controls in a balanced TWO-COLUMN / TWO-ROW arrangement: first row "工科实验室" and "代码空间"; second row "未来星系" and "AI智境". First is selected with a tiny warm gold star and fine gold underline. Respect generous comfortable touch spacing and clear off-white label contrast; no text truncation and no horizontal scrolling. This bottom zone y=82–98% sits on a restrained dark translucent navy scrim so water remains faintly visible underneath. Small helper just above it: "拖动探索星空 · 双指缩放". Real readable labels over atmosphere, no mysterious unlabeled destinations, no device home bar necessary. The mobile layout must be intentional and compact, visually related to the desktop interface rather than a screenshot scaled down.
FINISH: refined real astronomical photographic matte-painting, coherent fine grain, natural low-key cool lighting, silver/blue and a touch of champagne, calm sophistication and restrained spectacle. Exact Chinese words, clean baseline alignment, normal readable text, no invented slogan, no made-up user progress, no extra celestial menu objects, no glowing planet, no white explosion, no heavy cyberpunk panels, no industrial machinery, no watermark. Preserve the source design identity while changing the framing and placement to fit portrait.
